ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the port is labeled a-b, and on the right there is a 1 kΩ resistor directly connected across a and b, with the RTh arrow pointing to this port. The right-side terminal of the BJT is connected to node a; the middle terminal goes downward through a 10 kΩ resistor to the positive terminal of a 10.7 V voltage source, and the negative terminal of the voltage source is connected to the bottom node b; the left-side terminal is connected through a 10 Ω resistor to the positive terminal of a 15 V power supply, and the negative terminal of the 15 V power supply is also connected to the bottom node b. Reasoning: According to the method for finding Thevenin equivalent resistance, set the independent voltage sources to zero, that is, replace both the 15 V and 10.7 V voltage sources with short circuits. Therefore the base is connected to AC ground through 10 kΩ, and the port a-b still has 1 kΩ directly across it. Since VBE is treated as a constant, and beta = 100, looking in from the emitter, the base resistance 10 kΩ reflected to the emitter side is 10000/(beta+1) = 10000/101 Ω = 99.0099 Ω. This equivalent resistance is in parallel with the 1 kΩ on the port, so RTh = 1000 || (10000/101) = (1000 × 10000/101)/(1000 + 10000/101) = 90.09009 Ω. Kept to two decimal places, it is 90.09 Ω.

method.method_draft: First describe the image topology: identify a-b as the output port, with 1 kΩ from a to b, the emitter at node a, base through 10 kΩ to the 10.7 V source, and collector through 10 Ω to the 15 V source. To find RTh, set the independent voltage sources to AC ground. The base then sees 10 kΩ to ground. Since VBE is constant and β=100, reflect this base resistance into the emitter as 10 kΩ/(β+1)=10000/101 Ω. Finally combine it in parallel with the 1 kΩ resistor directly across a-b: RTh = 1000 || (10000/101), giving 90.09 Ω.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中端口标为 a-b，右侧有一个 1 kΩ 电阻直接跨接在 a 与 b 之间，RTh 箭头指向该端口。BJT 的右侧端子连接到节点 a；中间端子向下通过 10 kΩ 电阻接到 10.7 V 电压源的正端，电压源负端接到底部节点 b；左侧端子通过 10 Ω 电阻接到 15 V 电源的正端，15 V 电源负端也接到底部节点 b。
推理：按求 Thevenin 等效电阻的方法，将独立电压源置零，即 15 V 和 10.7 V 电压源都用短路代替。因此基极通过 10 kΩ 接交流地，端口 a-b 仍有 1 kΩ 直接跨接。由于 VBE 被视为常数，且 beta = 100，从发射极看进去，基极电阻 10 kΩ 反映到发射极侧为 10000/(beta+1) = 10000/101 Ω = 99.0099 Ω。该等效电阻与端口上的 1 kΩ 并联，所以 RTh = 1000 || (10000/101) = (1000 × 10000/101)/(1000 + 10000/101) = 90.09009 Ω。保留两位小数为 90.09 Ω。

method.method_draft: After describing the image, apply a small test voltage v at node a relative to b while keeping the 15 V and 10.7 V ideal sources fixed for incremental analysis. The visible 1 kΩ branch draws v/1000. Because VBE is constant, the base voltage changes by the same v; through the 10 kΩ base resistor this produces an incremental base current of v/10000 in magnitude. The emitter current contribution is (β+1)v/10000 = 101v/10000. Therefore the test current is i = v/1000 + 101v/10000, so RTh = v/i = 1/(1/1000 + 101/10000) = 90.09 Ω.
